'''Magnetic plates''' were components that were used to affix a device to a metallic surface. [[Proton charge]]s, such as the [[7-PrG proton grenade/Legends|7-PrG proton grenade]], featured a magnetic plate at the base. [[Surveillance tagger/Legends|Surveillance taggers]] also incorporated a magnetic plate that allowed them to be attached to vehicles and [[Droid/Legends|droids]].<ref name="EGWT" />
